hypothesis: Scoring and refit repeat ordered immutable occurrence pairs; numeric compatibility and current lifetime are separate gates.

baseline_contract.keeper: PAR_STRONG/FULL/TILED/Fixed3, unchanged production binary; separate read-only Host observer binary

hardware.scope: Historical capture provenance, not a new GPU allocation or current availability claim.

scope.evidence_mode: CPU analysis of existing original P2 snapshots and native C0 build capture, validated byte-identical against original POST tree/order/empty.

pair.owner: SHA256(sorted immutable occurrence members; little-endian int32 bytes); numeric node indices are decoding addresses only.
pair.level_alignment: construction scoring L -> refit L+1; also report same-level intersection.
pair.task_owner_matching: Maximize SAME_OWNER matches by exact (pair, canonical membership) multiset equality, then assign residual pair-matched tasks to DIFFERENT_OWNER.
pair.stage_matching: scoring and boundary overlaps are non-exclusive; union counted once.

numeric_gate.same_numeric: same input, arithmetic, accumulation, sqrt, rounding and representation
numeric_gate.convertible: exact deterministic low-cost conversion to the required refit enclosure without recomputing D960
numeric_gate.incompatible: captured scoring/boundary nominal arithmetic does not certify refit directed-rounding interval contract
numeric_gate.self_pairs: report separately as an optimistic source-contract admission ceiling for trivial zero conversion; not a bound on all possible conversion mechanisms or accidental equality
numeric_gate.per_pair_value_equality: unknown unless both producer and consumer outputs exist; refit currently captures aggregate node extrema, not per-pair intervals
numeric_gate.fma: source-explicit directed refit intrinsics known; pow overload/code-generation FMA in old binaries not disassembled here

decision.strong_overlap: both rebuilds identity >=0.8 AND certified numeric-compatible >=0.8
decision.conditional: identity >=0.5 AND numeric-compatible >=0.5 but strong gate not met
decision.no_go_reuse: identity <0.5 OR source-contract admitted numeric-compatible fraction including optimistic self-zero exception <0.5; decision is scoped to existing nominal outputs and bit-exact frozen refit arrays
decision.incomplete_gate: missing inputs or count mismatch stops analysis; no forced decision

storage: unique identity-overlap pairs times 4/8 bytes and separate 8/16-byte mapping; theoretical lower bounds only, not measured VRAM
